summary: Install from the catalog: Developer > Helm > Create > Helm Release, pick the Automation Portal chart, YAML view, replace clusterRouterBase apps.example.com (or validation fails), set pluginMode oci, optionally imageTagInfo, set orgs under the rhaap provider (default Default), optionally CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_URL, and click Create.
questions: How do I install self-service automation portal from the OpenShift Helm catalog?
What is clusterRouterBase in the portal chart?
Portal Helm chart validation fails with apps.example.com
How do I set the AAP organization in the portal Helm chart?

answer_card.title: Install the portal from the OpenShift catalog
answer_card.answer_md:
Developer view > **Helm > Create > Helm Release** > *Automation Portal* > YAML view:
```yaml
redhat-developer-hub:
  global:
    clusterRouterBase: apps.<your-cluster>  # must replace apps.example.com
    pluginMode: oci
    imageTagInfo: "2.1"   # optional plug-in version
  upstream:
    backstage:
      appConfig:
        catalog:
          providers:
            rhaap:
              '{{- include "catalog.providers.env" . }}':
                orgs: "<your-aap-organization-name>"
```
Optionally add `CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_URL` in `extraEnvVars`. Click **Create**. Leaving `apps.example.com` makes chart validation fail.
